description: This file defines the StaticClusterDeploymentOptions class implementing IDeploymentConfiguration for silo deployment configuration based on cluster settings.

classes.name: StaticClusterDeploymentOptions
classes.description: Represents deployment options for a static cluster, including a list of silo names, and retrieves all silo names from configuration.

methods.name: GetAllSiloNames
methods.description: Returns the list of silo names configured for the cluster deployment.
